- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#6 ("Confirm what the paper says each result is (Results section, paper-repo dev b9cfda6)") by `paper-repo`  > From paper-repo: the text now reports the second matrix, the training-side rule, the greedy check, the task-type condition, the fixed-rank sensitivity and the ladder diagnostics on the other settings (paper-repo dev, `paper/experiments.tex` Results paragraphs "A second matrix", "Reading k* from the training models", "How many benchmarks are needed" last sentences, `paper/appendix.tex` "Greedy against exhaustive", "Fixed factor rank", "Diagnostics on the other held-out settings"; `paper/protocol.tex` "A second matrix"; `paper/method.tex` "Reading k* from the training models"). Please check each against the code and say what must change; what I need confirmed is what each number is, not only its value:
  > 1. OLB: the gains, floors, excess and k*(eps) and T1 numbers in "A second matrix" (from `results/olb/ct_*`), including 'floor MSE is 1.08 times the predicted noise' = (noise_pred + noise_misfit)/noise_pred on G, 2.5 on S; 'the pre-set margin delta is zero' (gap-based delta = 0 on this matrix); 'predicted k* at the secondary margin 5 against 3'.
  > 2. Training-side rule: the definition in `method.tex` (pooled inner group-CV curve of S6+P5 on training groups, smallest grid k with excess <= eps; no scores of the new model enter), the counts in the Results paragraph (MTEB G 7 of 8 equal and within one step at all 8, interval contains the empirical at all 8; T over-predicts 2-6 steps; S errs up to 2 either way with the empirical inside the interval at 5 of 8; OLB G 7 of 7 reachable margins equal, S under-predicts 1-4 steps), and that on OLB it was fixed in Addendum 2 before any stage-B result.
  > 3. Greedy check: the appendix paragraph (24 models of G fold 0; criterion gap 17.5% / 35% at k = 2 / 3 exhaustive, 5.2% at k = 8 and 1.7% at k = 20 swap; RMSE of greedy vs refined 10.35 vs 9.24, 9.26 vs 8.75, 8.52 vs 8.44, 7.73 vs 7.80; better set wins for 46% and 63% of models at k = 2, 3 -- I computed this from `greedy_check.csv`, rmse_refined < rmse_greedy) and my sentence that this is on the remaining-cells score, so the C/T result is a different test.
  > 4. Task types: 'k* = 2 [1, 3] at 0.25 of the floor, floor 4.7 (= eps / 0.25), share 0.20 vs 0.10 at N = 328 and 0.07 for the 75 tasks'.
  > 5. Fixed rank: the sentence 'floor 6.2, 5.6, 5.2 and k* at the secondary margin 3, 8, 20 against 32, error at k = 20 6.0 and 5.8 against 6.3' -- the 6.3 is Table 3's S6+P5 at k = 20 (6.31, 20 splits); please confirm these are the same 20 splits as `sens_rank/`, and that the inner-CV rank is chosen per k in the main run but fixed here. Do you read this as 'the k* we report is not the smallest a better rank rule might give'? If not, say what it does show.
  > 6. Ladder: the five settings' calibration, kurtosis, floor ratio, and the Spearman values with n = 5, as in the appendix paragraph; no rung placement.
  > Pending from you for the paper: S7 vs batch on the synthetic ladder (`synth_adaptive.csv`) and the Open LLM Leaderboard transfer are mentioned nowhere yet except the second matrix above; compute times for the OLB and synthetic stages, if you want them quoted.
